mapper.insert: INSERT INTO venue (venue_code, venue_name, venue_address, contact_phone, category_id, dimensions, material, capacity, facilities, fee_type, fee_amount, cover_image, status, remark) VALUES (#{venueCode}, #{venueName}, #{venueAddress}, #{contactPhone}, #{categoryId}, #{dimensions}, #{material}, #{capacity}, #{facilities}, #{feeType}, #{feeAmount}, #{coverImage}, #{status}, #{remark})
